verdict.rationale: Fenwick's IP practice group page documents a patent prosecution practice. It says the firm prosecuted foundational patents for GoPro, Facebook, Twitter and Venmo, and cites Managing IP's 2026 'Firm of the Year - Nationwide for Patent Prosecution' award. Fenwick Labs also notes intelligent alerts for Patent clients. missing for 10: explicit description of portfolio strategy / building a defensible patent position, detail on drafting and filing workflow, named patent practitioners, independent corroboration beyond firm-published claims.
